description: T32 negative control: the same 100-attempt run as conservation/100-attempts.json, but 5 coordination rows (worker spawns / verifier runs) were silently collapsed into their parent attempts before the ledger was built -- the failure mode T32's backlog entry names ('retries collapsed into their parent, hiding cost'). Only 95 rows actually exist in the ledger, while a naive report still claims the original run size.
